title: Chapter 348 Wine Has Spiritual Aura
content:
Chapter 348 Wine Has Spiritual Aura

But what he couldn't understand was why Lu Daosheng wanted to treat this old guy's legs?

Let’s not talk about how stiff the relationship between the Jiang family and the Lin family is. Just because of Lin Xu’s coercion and temptation to Jiang Xiaoxiao, it shouldn’t be so reasonable.

It seems that some complicated things have happened to Lu Dao’s family during the period when he was born in the Lin family.

In an instant, Mr. Jiang's brain rotated rapidly.

"Oh? Old Li, haha, I didn't expect you to come too. We three haven't been together for a long time."

Just as Mr. Jiang was thinking, Lin Ye suddenly noticed the head of the Li family who was a little confused standing in the yard.

Listening to Lin Ye's slightly happy words, in an instant, the head of the Li family even felt that they were old friends.

But the reality is that they are not.

Not only that, they are also fierce competitors, almost storming in secret.

However, he had some connection with Jiang Guowei when he was young, so he had a very good relationship.

Before the head of the Li family could speak, Lin Ye had already greeted the Lin family to hold a banquet.

"Hahaha, today, we won't be drunk!"

Mr. Jiang looked at each other with the head of the Li family, with speechlessness in his eyes.

Who said he wanted to drink with you?

Mr. Jiang had no choice but to turn his head to look at Lu Daosheng.

He knew that the reason why the Lin family suddenly changed so much was because of Lu Daosheng.

"Xiaosen, are we going back?"

"Brother Sheng, why don't we go home and drink it? I just bought the wine."

The two looked at Lu Daosheng and whispered.

Seeing the two of them looking cautiously, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "Since the head of the Lin family is so enthusiastic, how can we leave? Let's stay and have some drinks."

"How is it, old man?"

Seeing that Lu Daosheng said this, Mr. Jiang hesitated for a moment and nodded slightly.

It just so happened that he had never tried drinking at the Tangtang Lin family.

Seeing that a few people were really planning to stay, Lin Ye was overjoyed and quickly pulled Lin Xu over, "Go and take out the good wine I had treasured for many years!"

"Yes, grandpa, I'll go now."

Hearing his grandfather's words, Lin Xu ran out without stopping.

Linye then called his granddaughter Lin Wennuan over.

"Grandpa, what should I do?"

Lin Wennuan said with a little delicate voice.

Seeing his granddaughter like this, Lin Ye nodded with satisfaction.

"Warm, grandpa gives you a very important thing. If this matter is done, our Lin family will usher in a glorious era."

Forestry said mysteriously towards Lin Wennuan.

"A glorious era?"

"Grandpa, what do you want me to do?"

Lin Wennuan asked curiously with her big eyes.

Lin Ye coughed lightly, then whispered a few words in Lin Wennuan's ear.

After a moment, Lin Wennuan's face suddenly turned red, and she looked at her grandfather with grievance and anger.

"Grandpa, how could you do this?"

Lin Wennuan's eyes were wet and she was almost crying.

Lin Ye couldn't bear to see this scene, but when he thought of the unknown future of the Lin family, he made up his mind again.

"Remember, you are a member of the Lin family, you are a member of the Lin family in your life, and you are a ghost of the Lin family in your death!"

"As long as the family can prosper, what is this sacrifice?"

Forestry had a stern face and shouted coldly.

Lin Wennuan stood there, her petite body trembling slightly, and tears fell down.

Faced with the orders from her grandfather, she finally had no choice but to surrender.

Soon, the bustling banquet was arranged by the Lin family.

But there were not many people. After all, there were only three people in the Jiang family and Lu Daosheng.

The Li family is the only head of the Li family, and it is because of Jiang Guowei.

So their Lin family just needs him.

Looking at his competitor who had been in his for many years and the strange head of the Li family sitting in the seat, Linye sorted out his expression and then walked up happily.

He knew that from then on, the two families would no longer be enemies.

In Yunshan City, an absolute overlord will appear.

And that overlord is the Jiang family.

There is no doubt that with him, the Jiang family has produced an amazing person.

At this time, Lin Xu ran over with a jar of wine.

"Grandpa, the wine is coming."

Hearing this, everyone's eyes immediately looked at Lin Xu who was running over.

To be precise, it is the wine jar in Lin Xu's hands.

They were very curious about what the head of the Lin family would look like if he had treasured the good wine for many years.

But when they looked over, they were suddenly disappointed.

It's just a very ordinary jar, and it's probably a lot in the countryside.

And they didn't smell the wine at all.

If forestry didn't say it, no one would think it was a wine jar.

Mr. Jiang, who was already a little expectant, glanced at him and withdrew his gaze, and snorted unconsciously.

That's it?

The head of the Li family smiled and said, "It is worthy of being the wine that the head of the Lin family has collected for many years. It is really hidden."

He spoke praises, but the lines were filled with sarcasm.

Lu Daosheng sat lazily in his seat, with a faint smile on his face and did not speak.

Seeing that everyone had no reaction, Lin Ye coughed lightly and laughed, "Everyone, this wine is not ordinary. This is the ancestral wine of our Lin family. The richest man in the next city came here to buy it and I didn't sell it."

In a word, forestry shows how precious this wine is.

After all, someone is supporting him.

Everyone suddenly became interested again. Just as they were trying to say something, Forestry had gently lifted the lid of the wine jar.

In an instant, a scent of wine came.

Everyone was stunned and intoxicated.

Jiang Xiaoxiao, Lin Wennuan and others had a rosy face, and they were already a little drunk.

"What a wine!"

A trace of color flashed in Mr. Jiang's eyes, and he blurted out at the wine jar in Forestry's hand.

The head of the Li family shut up.

Seeing this, although Lin Ye felt a little distressed, he smiled again when he thought of the future of the Lin family.

"How is it, Lin didn't lie to you, right?"

At this time, Lu Daosheng looked at the jar of wine with a look of excitement.

There was a little spiritual energy in this wine!

Aura!

Blue Star actually has spiritual energy.

You know, although Lu Daosheng has not been back for a long time, he can tell whether he has spiritual energy at a glance.

Anyway, this is the first time he has seen spiritual energy in the entire Yunshan City.

After reacting, Lu Daosheng's expression became a little solemn.

He did not forget the purpose of his return this time.

The system said that it will give him some inspiration here.

Break the status quo and find new heights of inspiration.

Just when he wanted to think carefully, Lin Ye had already ordered Lin Wennuan to come and pour him wine.

At this time, everyone's cup was still empty.

Lu Daosheng quickly reacted and then spoke, "Let's throw it to Mr. Jiang first."

Hearing this, Lin Wennuan was stunned, but nodded.

Mr. Jiang, who was beside him, smiled with relief.

"You boy understand me."
